ideas.pitch: An offline-first decision support tool for tracking and optimizing drug-resistant tuberculosis drug repurposing shortlists using localized genomic mutation markers.
ideas.title: TB-Guard AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets problem statement BB-PB-01 under Precision Biotherapeutics and Drug Discovery, offering judges an immediate, practical tool for urgent clinical needs.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight web viewer for protein structures that highlights potential binding sites and flags mutations prone to drug resistance.
ideas.title: FoldExplorer Lite
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly addresses problem statement BB-PB-02 with a working visual interface that bioinformatics judges can test live during judging.

ideas.pitch: An IoT and mobile dashboard simulator that tracks temperature breaches and predicts spoilage risk for biologics and vaccines in last-mile transit.
ideas.title: ColdChain Sentinel
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly maps to problem statement BB-PB-03, emphasizing measurable economic and health impact by preventing vaccine degradation.

ideas.pitch: An agricultural biotechnology app that analyzes leaf microbiome profiles via image uploads to recommend targeted bio-pesticides.
ideas.title: AgriBio YieldGuard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the agricultural biotechnology theme, offering a highly practical tool for local farmers with a live image-upload demonstration.

ideas.pitch: A monitoring dashboard for environmental biotechnology plants optimizing microbial consortium ratios for industrial wastewater treatment.
ideas.title: EnviroDigest AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals to the environmental biotechnology domain by demonstrating concrete economic and ecological efficiency gains through real-time sensor data simulation.
